Uncertainties

■ Determination of 'real' rock mass parameters is usually very difficult.

■ Methods like Hoek-Brown rely on simplifications and estimations.

 Back analysis of displacements of 1st tube permits a check of the range of rock parameters

■ Interpretation of monitored displacements in 1970ies: no standard 3D monitoring monitoring sections were installed later than nowadays  documented displacements were set as lower limits
